pr.title: Add bulk folder deletion from the files grid
pr.body:
## Scope

What's changed:

- Add `DeleteFolderDialog` component with a radio input: **move contents one level up** or **recursively delete all contents**
- Replace the inline sidebar folder-delete dialog with the new `DeleteFolderDialog`, making both sidebar and grid deletion consistent
- Add `FolderSection` component to display subfolders as cards inside the files grid layout
- Support bulk folder selection in the cards layout via `extraSelection` / `hasPrependContent` props and a `#prepend` slot
- Enable batch deletion of folders (and mixed folder+file selections) from the files grid header bar, respecting per-collection delete permissions

## Potential Risks / Drawbacks

- `moveAndDelete` calls `moveSingleFolder` in parallel across selected folders. If both a parent and its child were in `folders`, the parallel execution would cause the child's contents to end up under the soon-to-be-deleted parent. No fix was applied because the scenario is impossible in the current UI: `FolderSection` only renders siblings (same-level folders), and `folderSelection` is cleared on every navigation, so a parent and one of its descendants can never be co-selected.
- `recursiveDelete` relies on `allFolders` being a complete snapshot of the tree. If the folder tree is very large and not fully loaded in the store, deeply nested descendant folders may not be collected and would be left behind after deletion.
- The `watch(folders, refresh)` in `collection.vue` will trigger a file list refresh on any folder store change, including unrelated mutations (e.g. rename, move). This is intentional but adds extra requests.

## Tested Scenarios

- Select multiple sibling folders and delete with "move content up": files and subfolders appear at the parent level
- Select multiple sibling folders and delete with "delete all content": all nested files and subfolders are removed
- Delete a single folder from the sidebar context menu using the new dialog
- Select a mix of files and folders and trigger batch delete: file-only dialog appears when no folders are selected; folder dialog appears when folders are selected
- Navigate between folders and confirm selection resets and no stale content flashes

```
Root
├── F1/                        ← empty folder
├── F2/
│   └── file-a.jpg
├── F3/
│   ├── file-b.jpg
│   └── F3-1/                  ← subfolder
│       └── file-c.jpg
├── F4/                        ← sibling of F3, for multi-select tests
│   └── file-d.jpg
└── file-root.jpg              ← loose file at root
```

```
F1 — empty folder
Select F1 → delete (move) → F1 disappears, nothing else changes
Select F1 → delete (delete all) → same

F2 — folder with file
Select F2 → delete (move) → F2 disappears, file-a.jpg appears at root
Select F2 → delete (delete all) → F2 and file-a.jpg are gone

F3 — folder with file + subfolder
Select F3 → delete (move) → F3 disappears, file-b.jpg and F3-1 appear at root
Select F3 → delete (delete all) → F3, file-b.jpg, F3-1, and file-c.jpg are all gone

F3 + F4 — multi-select siblings
Select F3 + F4 → delete (move) → both disappear, file-b.jpg, F3-1, file-d.jpg appear at root
Select F3 + F4 → delete (delete all) → all gone

F2 + file-root.jpg — mixed selection
Select F2 + file-root.jpg → delete → folder dialog appears (radio options shown) → confirm → F2, file-a.jpg, and file-root.jpg are all gone

file-root.jpg — files only
Select file-root.jpg → delete → simple confirm dialog (no radio options) → confirm → file gone
```

## Checklist

- [x] Added or updated tests
- [x] Documentation PR created [here](https://github.com/directus/docs) or not required
- [x] OpenAPI package PR created [here](https://github.com/directus/openapi) or not required

---

Fixes #CMS-1442

review_comments.body: this computed is also defined [here](https://github.com/directus/directus/pull/26886/changes#diff-18191896fea419f514d6dcc68cb2225cb12476815a8e6d3236c70f3f606e16f1R15). I would pick one place to avoid multiple sources of truth. Maybe pass it as a prop from this component down to the folder-section component.
I believe nextTick is [still referenced in this file](https://github.com/directus/directus/blob/f88520d6b2a7defc6ed44810c34e10021c6010b5/app/src/modules/files/routes/collection.vue#L238)
The refresh is triggered twice here, since it is also triggered by the watcher, so you should be able to remove this one.
I think there's enough going on in this file to warrant extracting much of the logic into a composable and adding some tests for it.

Let's maybe nest these?

```
delete_folder:
  move_content: Move content one level up
  // etc
```

You'll also have to amend the strings where they are used in the app. `delete_folder_move_content` -> `delete_folder.move_content`
